paper: McQuade et al.2026 Transcriptional regulation of disease-relevant microglial activation programs
primary_literature_limitations: State labels are not simple healthy versus harmful categories.
Effects and knockdown efficiency depend on cell model.
More amyloid uptake may coexist with increased synapse engulfment.
LysoTracker intensity is not a direct calibrated lysosomal pH readout.
Author dashboard confidence labels are descriptive curation, not our model validation.
selection_rubric: First inspect full prespecified frozen-model and real-donor ranking, then primaryROSMAP crosscheck.
Prefer a measured stable within-subtype signal when human functional perturbation evidence supports a testable direction.
If a regulator is unmeasured, label that choice as literature-derived from a downstream program; do not attribute direct regulator inference to PG.
No automated signature reversal is equated with therapeutic benefit.
Select a falsifiable lab experiment, with cell-survival and synapse-preservation readouts alongside the intended molecular endpoint.
If no robust model signal survives, state the negative result rather than making a model-discovery claim.
